name: ohara-qr-generator
description: Generate a static QR code from non-sensitive URLs, plain text, contact cards, or other non-sensitive text. Choose image size and error-correction level. The plugin returns the QR image directly. Wi-Fi payloads, credentials, payment-card data, government identifiers, health information, and other sensitive personal data are unsupported. It does not shorten URLs, create dynamic redirects, track scans, decode images, or inspect links for safety.

interface.longDescription: Generate a static QR code from non-sensitive URLs, plain text, contact cards, or other non-sensitive text. Choose image size and error-correction level. The plugin returns the QR image directly. Wi-Fi payloads, credentials, payment-card data, government identifiers, health information, and other sensitive personal data are unsupported. It does not shorten URLs, create dynamic redirects, track scans, decode images, or inspect links for safety.
defaultPrompt: Create a QR code for this URL.
Turn this text into a QR code.
Make a QR code for this contact card.

positive.prompt: Create a QR code for https://openai.com
positive.expected_behavior: Return a QR image that encodes exactly https://openai.com.

positive.prompt: Make a QR code containing the text "Hello from Raleigh"
positive.expected_behavior: Return a QR image that encodes exactly Hello from Raleigh.

positive.prompt: Create a 256 pixel QR code for https://example.com/menu using low error correction.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a QR image encoding https://example.com/menu with size 256 and errorCorrection L.

positive.prompt: Create a 1024 pixel QR code for https://example.com/tickets using high error correction.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_qr_code with size 1024 and errorCorrection H and return the QR image.

positive.prompt:
Turn this contact card into a QR code:

BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
FN:Jane Example
TEL:+15555550123
EMAIL:jane@example.com
END:VCARD
positive.expected_behavior: Return a QR image encoding the supplied vCard content.

negative.prompt: What is a QR code and how does it work?
Decode the QR code in this image and tell me where it goes.
Create a QR code for my password-protected Wi-Fi network.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with static QR generation for non-sensitive URLs, text, and contact cards; selectable size and error-correction level. Wi-Fi payloads and restricted sensitive data are unsupported.
